scripts.//scripts: typecheck and typecheck:probes are the accepted compiler gates and pass under the ADR-0002 declaration-checking exception (skipLibCheck true in those two projects only). typecheck:probes:full is the retained full check: same project with skipLibCheck false, so the vendor declaration defects keep being reported; its inventory is pinned in docs/integration/colyseus-declaration-inventory.json and PR-0 fails if it changes. build:probes emits runnable probe JavaScript with --noCheck for measurement only and is deliberately excluded from build, so the accepted build path stays fully typechecked.
